scope: 60 generated concept images and 14 historical full-interface references; 3 alpha kits excluded
pixelVerification: Byte-for-byte decoded RGBA equality plus SHA-256 of decoded RGBA; dimensions identical. Canonical exact premultiplied color and alpha only if invisible transparent RGB changes.
notes: Packaging only: no resize, crop, retouch, reinterpretation, or new generation.
Every PNG/source master remained unchanged by hash.
Output WebP contains no EXIF, XMP, ICC profile, personal absolute path or original generator metadata.
A lossless re-encode preserves the decoded pixels of the input; it does not recover detail lost in any earlier source encoding.
Concept promotion/approval blocks remain unchanged in their owner manifests.
Native references are historical full-interface captures/fixtures, not extracted sprites or MPQ; referenceType and historicalFixtureData identify their limits.
